title: Environment-dependent degradation pathways of pure zinc induced by acid–alkali surface chemistry
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20433-20447
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00345A, Paper

Abdalla Abdal-hay, Enmao Xiang, Yahia Ali, Jiaqi Xu, Yu Kyoung Kim
A simple acid–alkali surface treatment tailors pure zinc's degradation in a medium-specific way, enabling more uniform and controlled biodegradation in physiological environments without alloying.
